local_software_tests.command: cd model; SSRI_EXECUTION_MODE=local; poetry run pytest --tb=no -q
local_software_tests.note: The full run used --tb=no, so the assertion text was not captured. Re-running that test alone passed in 31.52s. The failure did not reproduce. Skipped tests are the two distributed integration tests and are not passes.

failures.test: Real model inference on the deployment
failures.expected: A valid 13-channel input produces finite 3-class softmax probabilities from SSRIModel
failures.actual: POST /api/v1/assess and POST /api/v1/inference return 401 before any checkpoint is loaded
failures.root_cause: Production API-key authentication is enabled. No production API key was used. The route also expects server-side checkpoint and feature paths, not an uploaded tensor.

failures.expected: Ready is false when the assessment model cannot be loaded
failures.actual: GET /api/v1/ready returned 200 ready=true with PostgreSQL and Redis only. The payload has no model or checkpoint field.
failures.root_cause: readiness() validates service config, output disk, and infrastructure health, not a checkpoint.

failures.expected: softmax over subsidence, landslide, and sinkhole sums to 1
failures.actual: Not observed live. Repository assess path applies torch.sigmoid per logit. The geospatial runner applies softmax.
failures.root_cause: run_mc_dropout and the GeoTIFF branch use sigmoid on a model trained with masked cross-entropy.

failures.test: User session can run an assessment
failures.expected: After login, the assessment request is authenticated as that user
failures.actual: Assess uses API-key auth. Platform routes use the Supabase access token. They are different credentials.
failures.root_cause: submitAssess attaches NEXT_PUBLIC_SSRI_API_KEY, not the Supabase session.

warnings: Swagger UI is enabled at /docs on the deployed API.
Default SSRIModel dropout is 0, so MC samples do not vary. That is not calibrated uncertainty.
The model does not check that channel 8 is NDVI. Order is the caller's responsibility via CHANNEL_NAMES.
Foundation checkpoints label v2 internally as ssri-foundation-v1 and are not assess-loadable.
Demo mode could not be read from the live process. It is checked only after API-key authentication.
Invalid login and unknown account return the same message.
limitations: Software results are not scientific validation. Status remains NOT_VALIDATED.
Local USGS v3 stacks have empty NDVI, NDWI, clay-mineral, and iron-oxide channels. Those values were not invented or replaced.
Distributed integration tests are skipped unless SSRI_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1. A skip is not a pass.
NaN and Inf rejection was not exercised on the deployment because authentication stopped the request. In the repository, SSRIModel.forward still accepts non-finite tensors.
